Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams audio chunks from an async source using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 2 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 3 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 4 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 5 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 6 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import asyncio
import json
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Callable, List, Optional

from deepgram import (
    DeepgramClient,
    LiveOptions,
    LiveTranscriptionEvents,
    LiveTranscriptionEvent,
)


@dataclass
class TranscriptionResult:
    text: str
    is_final: bool
    raw: dict


class DeepgramStreamingSpeechToText:
    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        model: str = "nova-2",
        language: str = "en",
        punctuate: bool = True,
        interim_results: bool = True,
    ):
        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY must be set")

        self.model = model
        self.language = language
        self.punctuate = punctuate
        self.interim_results = interim_results
        self._client = DeepgramClient(self.api_key)

    async def transcribe(
        self,
        audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes],
        sample_rate: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        encoding: str = "linear16",
        endpointing: int = 300,
    ) -> List[TranscriptionResult]:
        results: List[TranscriptionResult] = []
        done = asyncio.Event()
        stream = self._client.listen.websocket.v("1")

        def on_message(
            _self,
            result: LiveTranscriptionEvent,
            **kwargs,
        ):
            try:
                payload = result.to_dict()
                channel = payload.get("channel", {})
                alternatives = channel.get("alternatives", [])
                transcript = ""
                if alternatives:
                    transcript = alternatives[0].get("transcript", "") or ""
                is_final = bool(payload.get("is_final", False))

                if transcript:
                    results.append(
                        TranscriptionResult(
                            text=transcript,
                            is_final=is_final,
                            raw=payload,
                        )
                    )
            except Exception as exc:
                results.append(
                    TranscriptionResult(
                        text="",
                        is_final=False,
                        raw={"error": str(exc)},
                    )
                )

        def on_close(*args, **kwargs):
            done.set()

        def on_error(*args, **kwargs):
            done.set()

        stream.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_message)
        stream.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Close, on_close)
        stream.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Error, on_error)

        options = LiveOptions(
            model=self.model,
            language=self.language,
            punctuate=self.punctuate,
            interim_results=self.interim_results,
            sample_rate=sample_rate,
            channels=channels,
            encoding=encoding,
            endpointing=endpointing,
        )

        if not stream.start(options):
            raise RuntimeError("Failed to start Deepgram streaming websocket")

        try:
            async for chunk in audio_chunks:
                if chunk:
                    stream.send(chunk)
            stream.finish()
            await asyncio.wait_for(done.wait(), timeout=30)
        finally:
            try:
                stream.finish()
            except Exception:
                pass

        return results


async def stream_audio_from_async_source(
    source: AsyncIterable[bytes],
    transcriber: DeepgramStreamingSpeechToText,
) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    results = await transcriber.transcribe(source)
    for item in results:
        if item.text:
            yield item.text


async def transcribe_audio_chunks(
    audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes],
    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[str]:
    transcriber = DeepgramStreamingSpeechToText(api_key=api_key)
    results = await transcriber.transcribe(audio_chunks)
    return [r.text for r in results if r.text]
